entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or exchanges, press three.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-C-45.
Okay, one moment while I look that up for you... VF-881-C-45. I see an order here for the Aero-Vent Pro Jersey. Is that correct?
Yes, the jersey. It's the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the fit? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just too tight across the chest. Listen, I don't need a diagnosis, just a return label. Can you do that or not?

Of course. I just need to verify the timeline. I see it was delivered 77 days ago. Let me just check our current policy... Yes, you are still within our 90-day return window. I can process this right now. Did you want a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
A refund. Just send the label to the email on file.

No problem. I have just processed your return request. The pre-paid shipping label has been sent to your email. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
